guide.title: User guide
guide.subtitle: A clear walkthrough of Cutiva — from recipes to project, then cutting and purchase.

overview.heading: Workshop workflow
overview.intro: Each area has one job. The natural order is:
overview.li1: Define aluminum, glass, and accessories in Resources.
overview.li2: Set the product recipe (how each part length comes from width and height).
overview.li3: In the project, enter the customer size and pick model and materials.
overview.li4: After calculate, lengths feed cutting plans and the buy list.

recipes.whatBody: Instead of hand-calculating every bar for every size, define the recipe once: parts, length formulas, glass, and accessories. Then customer size is enough.
recipes.formulaLine: Recipe + customer size (W × H) = ready cut list
recipes.seedHint: Seed numbers are samples — edit them to match your workshop before relying on them.
recipes.map1: Product types, then models (sliding, hinged, tilt…).
recipes.map2: Model card: name, sash count, overlap, available for use.
recipes.fieldSashM: How many sashes in the unit
recipes.fieldOverlapE: Added to effective width when division is on
recipes.fieldActiveM: Is the model available day to day?
recipes.fieldActiveE: Off = hard to pick in projects
recipes.diagramsIntro: Width, height, clearance, and overlap arrows — workshop logic.
recipes.lengthFormula:
Length = (width factor × effective W) + (height factor × H) + clearance/offset
Effective W = full width  OR  (width ÷ sash count) + overlap
recipes.effectiveW: If sash-width division is off: effective W = full width. If on: sash width + overlap.
recipes.simpleSentence: Simple sentence: length = width or height ± clearance (cm), qty.
recipes.ex4: Two sashes + 2.5 cm overlap on W 200: effective W = 100 + 2.5 = 102.5 cm
recipes.glassBody: Each opening: glass W and H (same ± clearance sentence), pane count, and whether required on the project.
recipes.accBody: Per product = qty × units. Per sash = qty × sash count × units.
recipes.emptyHeading: If you leave a field empty
recipes.emptyIntro: Some blanks reject save; some silently default; some block the project later.
recipes.emptyOverlapR: Treated as 0 — no add to sash width
recipes.emptyMaterialR: Must pick material on the project or calculate fails

project.heading: Project
project.intro: Enter the customer size and apply the recipe to a real item.
project.step1: Create a project and pick the workshop.
project.step2: Add an item: product type + model + width and height.
project.step3: Pick aluminum per part, glass if required, and accessories.
project.step4: Calculate — lengths, quantities, and cost appear.
project.step5: Send results to cutting or a quote depending on your plan.
project.missingHint: Missing material or required glass stops calculate with a clear message — check the item choices.

cutting.heading: Cutting and purchase
cutting.intro: After project calculate, lengths feed bar nesting on market stock.
cutting.step1: Pick the project or required lengths.
cutting.step2: Generate a cutting plan — pieces on bars with waste.
cutting.step3: Review the buy list and remnants if your plan includes them.
cutting.remnantsHint: Confirmed remnants are used on the next run before buying new bars.

diagrams.frameSashAria: Frame and sash drawing with width, height, and clearance
diagrams.frameSashCaption: Outer frame and inner sash — W and H arrows plus clearance between frame and sash.
diagrams.clearanceAria: Diagram of clearance between frame and sash
diagrams.clearanceCaption: Clearance makes the sash smaller than the frame opening so it fits and moves.
diagrams.overlapAria: Two-sash overlap on a sliding window
diagrams.overlapCaption: Gold zone = overlap O between sashes; it feeds effective width.
diagrams.sashShorter: Sash shorter than frame by clearance
diagrams.stepClearanceIdle: Press “Play teaching” to see clearance form.
diagrams.stepClearance1: 1) Sash matches the frame opening — no clearance yet.
diagrams.stepClearance2: 2) Sash shrinks inward — that gap is clearance.
diagrams.stepClearance3: 3) In the recipe: usually “height − clearance” or “width − clearance”.
diagrams.stepOverlapIdle: Press “Play teaching” to see sash overlap.
diagrams.stepOverlap1: 1) Two sashes side by side with no overlap.
diagrams.stepOverlap2: 2) A sash slides — the gold strip (overlap O) appears.
diagrams.stepFrameIdle: Press “Play teaching” to build frame and sash step by step.
diagrams.stepFrame1: 1) Outer frame (frame) — top, bottom, and jamb.
diagrams.stepFrame2: 2) Sash and glass inside the frame.
diagrams.stepFrame3: 3) Dimension arrows: width W, height H, and clearance.
diagrams.stepFrame4: 4) Part labels — these are what you tune in the recipe.
